summary: Jersey Mike's Subs (NYSE: JMKE) disclosed in an 8-K that Blackstone-affiliated funds, its majority owners, pledged 127,631,450 Class A shares, 44,990,370 Class B shares and 44,990,370 HoldCo units — about 54.3% of outstanding Class A on an as-exchanged basis — as collateral under margin loan agreements with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding as administrative agent, adding to existing facilities for roughly $1.09 billion of aggregate borrowings dated September 16, 2026. The company is not a party, delivered remediation-standstill letters to lenders, and no board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch foreclosure risk and share overhang.
